description: NaBiO₃ is Ilmenite structured and crystallizes in the trigonal R̅3 space group. Na¹⁺ is bonded to six equivalent O²⁻ atoms to form distorted NaO₆ pentagonal pyramids that share corners with nine equivalent BiO₆ octahedra, edges with three equivalent NaO₆ pentagonal pyramids, and  a faceface with one BiO₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 40-62°. There are three shorter (2.34 Å) and three longer (2.53 Å) Na-O bond lengths. Bi⁵⁺ is bonded to six equivalent O²⁻ atoms to form BiO₆ octahedra that share corners with nine equivalent NaO₆ pentagonal pyramids, edges with three equivalent BiO₆ octahedra, and  a faceface with one NaO₆ pentagonal pyramid. There are three shorter (2.11 Å) and three longer (2.16 Å) Bi-O bond lengths. O²⁻ is bonded in a distorted see-saw-like geometry to two equivalent Na¹⁺ and two equivalent Bi⁵⁺ atoms.
